name: Pier-Luc Funk
bio: Pier-Luc Funk is a Canadian film and television actor from Quebec. He is most noted for his role as Maxime in the 2018 film Genesis, for which he received a Prix Iris nomination for Best Supporting Actor at the 21st Quebec Cinema Awards.  Wikipedia
